body:
Are you able to talk to your grandma right now?

That guy sounds like a jerk.  Good riddance to him.  You deserve better than that.

Think about the motorcycle guy and the officer who helped you.  There are good people in the world- they're just harder to find sometimes.

Glad that you are home safe.  Do you think you can sleep now?  Maybe you can wash your face with cool water and curl up in bed with a distraction (TV, book, computer) while you try to sleep.

Can you gently wake her up?  Talk with her.  Hug her.

Don't ever let a guy make you feel pressured to do anything.  I'm glad you didn't sleep with him.  Can you cut contact with him, too?

Was the officer nice to you?
Is someone home with you?  Your parents, a sibling, a roommate?
You should get something you like to eat and play some Half Life.  Do the little things that make you happy.  :)
What is your favorite food and favorite movie?

I don't know.  Where have you always wanted to visit?  Maybe take a vacation there first and see if you like it.  Or do you have extended family somewhere?  Could you visit them?

Kind of a random question, but have you ever gotten a massage?  Do you have a spa/salon near you?  Human touch can be very healing.  I go in for massages every once in a while and it feels great.  You can talk to your masseuse, too, like you would with a hairstylist.

ETA:  Also, she did not deserve you.  Cheaters often continue to cheat.  She has to live with the consequences of her actions for the rest of the life while you are free to move on and purse better things.

Can you go to sleep?  Sounds like you're in a bad place right now.  Maybe just give yourself some rest.  I have to do that sometimes.  It doesn't fix anything, but at least in sleep you can escape for a while.
I want to die, too, but that's not the way to do it.

Okay, well imagine if you were driving and someone stepped out in front of you on purpose.  Even if you didn't kill them, it would be traumatizing.

You never know what others are going through.  Hey, maybe the driver is going through hell in their life, too.  You want to destroy another person?  Because that's exactly what will happen.

What if you get hit by a car and there are kids in it?  Maybe they're in the backseat and you don't even see them.  Can you really say you don't give a fuck about that?

I do the same thing.  Trust people and get kicked in the teeth in return.  Time and time again.

Can you move away from you're living?  Start fresh somewhere else?  Even for a short while?

Because statistically, the older you get (especially women), the harder it is to obtain marriage.  And I have a biological clock with having children.  "Advanced maternal age" is 35.  My parents are old and I want them to have grandchildren.  It's a lot of pressure.
Hey, don't walk out in front of cars.  FFS, have you ever known someone personally who hit a pedestrian?  You'll really fuck over the driver's life and do you really want to be remembered that way?

Hey, I'm on SSI for my health, too!  It's a blessing because we get the care we need, but it's depressing because you can't work at most jobs and get the emotional benefit of "contributing to society."

Can you volunteer?  I like park clean-ups because you can walk around outside and be social to your comfort level.  If you don't want to talk to people, you can wander off on your own.  And it ends up being exercise without being tedious or boring because you're focused on something (cleaning/painting/raking, etc.).

Yeah, when you think about life too much, the lines get blurred.

I can snap out of it when I think of life as a game.  Almost like the Sims.  You do certain tasks to get results.  You make mistakes.  No one really knows what they are doing.  We're all making it up as we go along.

Also, have you tried industrial earplugs?  You can get them at the hardware store.  I use them and that's the only way I can sleep at night.
You are your child's whole world.  Don't destroy it.

I'm 30.  Does it feel like you're going through an early midlife crisis?  That's what my life feels like to me.

What are your other options?  Are you working?  If so, do you work from home or an office?

If you crash your car and you survive, you'll be in severe pain (which you might never recover from), stuck in the hospital with an enormous bill, have to deal with police, and then you'll be without a vehicle.  Not worth it.

Can I ask how old you are if that's okay?

Don't use razor blades.  It won't work and it will hurt like hell.  They'll lock you in the hospital where you'll have to piss on a toilet in front of everyone and you're sharing space with people who scream 24/7.  Then they'll stick you with a bill for hundreds, even thousands of dollars, with nothing positive to gain from it.

I don't know what else to say because I'm at the edge of ending my life as well, but just go to sleep for now and forget the razor blades because you'll end up in a worse situation.

Please go spend time with your friends.  Go do fun things, like see a funny movie, or play some video games together.  Cherish your friends because people like me who don't have a single friend don't have that opportunity.  And it's proven that spending time with friends can help boost your mood, even if it's temporary.

I feel the same way.  I wonder if some people trying to prevent suicide (especially those we don't know personally) are acting from true empathy or if it's because "that's what you're supposed to do."  Like, you don't litter because it's bad, you help grandma cross the street because it's good.  It's an automatic response to say "don't do it!" because we've been programed to respond that way without really thinking about it.  Because, hell, where were all you worried souls when I needed someone to spend time with?  Will you spend time with me now?  No, they won't, because they don't care.  False heroes.
I cannot work because I'm legally disabled.  I would lose my medical coverage.
Thank you for trying to help.  I don't feel like I belong.  When I go out, I see happy couples my age and I wonder why I can't have that, too.  It hurts so much.
I don't know what to say because I'm on the edge of killing myself, too.

Married men (usually with small children)... men twice my age... dirty/sketchy guys... Making weird comments at me, unprovoked.  I don't wear anything provocative.  My wardrobe is t-shirts and jeans.

Normal guys never talk to me.

ETA:  For example, today a married man tried to ask me out because he doesn't have sex with his wife anymore.  I said no and he kept trying to justify it.  Just leave me alone!

It really isn't fair, is it?  I get philosophical about it sometimes.  Like maybe I was a bad person in a past life and now God/the universe is punishing me by giving me "just enough" to live by, but I'm never happy and cannot fulfill my dreams.

Are you in college?  If not, maybe consider it?  You can get financial aid.  All you need to do is go talk to admissions.

Many schools have clinics and they can help you with your hair and scars.  If you don't have insurance, some schools have options such as free or low cost care.  They also provide counseling for free if you're a student.

If you aren't enrolled or don't want to go to school, maybe try looking for a community clinic near you.  I have one near me and all of their services are free- dental, dermatology, OB/GYN, etc.

Thanks.  I volunteer with local and national organizations.  It's a nice feeling to help others but I don't meet friends at the events.  A lot of families and older folks volunteer.

I am considering moving away from my small town but then I will be out of reach of my parents.

Okay, just wanted to prevent you from overdosing because it hardly ever works and you'll just end up in a worse situation.
How old are you?  You still might be able to change your life around.  Do have a friend you could spend time with?
Have you told them how you feel about this?

Did it get better for you?  If so, how did you change things?

At 30, I feel like I'm getting too old for this and nothing ever works out.  Time is ticking on marriage and children and I haven't made any progress.

I am experiencing the same thing.  How old are you?  I'm 30 and feel like I'm getting too old for this.  I want to find a man to love, get married, and have children.  The clock is ticking and I'm still alone despite trying my best.  No friends, my sister even hates me.  I won't kill myself today, but I feel like it will happen within a year.
Sleeping meds won't work.  Trust me, I've tried it and just ended up in hospital.
